description:
P21/06-01 probe (work/design/final_probes.json 'P21', work/design/part06-design-v1.md's instruction that lesson 06-01 needs the REAL conversion output, not an invented one): CVTRPGSRC-converts the already hardware-verified RPG III program R0408A (<USER>2/QRPGSRC, docs/part04/04-08-jucinq3-report.md - 'ACME TRADING CO' report with J00001/J00003, confirmed non-interactive via QSYSPRT+EXCPT, confirmed CRTRPGPGM'd with Highest Severity 00 on 2026-09-25) into &LIB/QRPGLE112(V0601A), then compiles and CALLs the converted RPG IV member to confirm it produces the same output as R0408A. Does NOT touch or recreate R0408A's own source - it already exists on the real machine; this manifest only reads it via CVTRPGSRC. &LIB defaults to <USER>2 (verify/lib/clgen.mjs: 'manifest.library || cfg.user.toUpperCase()+"2"'), matching where R0408A itself was compiled and hardware-verified.

CVTRPGSRC syntax verified against work/design/refs/ilerpgprogguide75.txt lines ~33130-33540 ('The CVTRPGSRC Command'), with one important CORRECTION to this task's own starting assumption:

  - CVTRPT's default is actually *YES, not *NO. The task instruction to 'confirm the CVTRPT default is *NO (must be explicit *YES)' does not match the reference: Table 120 ('Conversion Feedback') explicitly lists 'CVTRPT(*YES) Determines whether to produce conversion report' (line 33165), and the worked example under 'Performing a Trial Conversion' states outright: 'The CVTRPT parameter should be specified as *YES -- this is also the default. If it is not, then the conversion will stop immediately' (lines 33470-33471). This manifest still specifies CVTRPT(*YES) explicitly (harmless either way, and self-documenting), but the description here corrects the premise rather than silently going along with it.
  - TOFILE must already exist before CVTRPGSRC runs: 'The converted source file must exist and should have a record length of 112 characters' (lines 33278-33280), and 'Note: The files QRPGLESRC and QRNCVTLG must already exist' (line 33416) - CVTRPGSRC does NOT auto-create its target source file. QRPGLE112 is also not among the source files verify/tools/qclsrc/txsetup.clp auto-creates (only QDDSSRC is), so the first step here is an explicit CRTSRCPF FILE(&LIB/QRPGLE112) RCDLEN(112) (112 is not a guess - it is the reference's own stated required record length, and matches the file's own name).
  - LOGFILE defaults to QRNCVTLG, which 'must already exist' too if not *NONE (line 33369, 'Unless *NONE is specified, there must be a log file... Create the log file by using the CPYF command with the From object file QARNCVTLG in library QRPGLE') - this manifest specifies LOGFILE(*NONE) explicitly to avoid a second prerequisite object this probe does not otherwise need (the conversion REPORT, not the audit LOG, is what 06-01 needs per work/design/part06-design-v1.md). This means the P21 probe description's own '...レポートとログを見る' (report AND log) is only half-covered here - the report is retrieved, the log file is deliberately skipped. Flagging this as a deliberate scope-narrowing, not an oversight.
  - 'If you try to convert a member that already exists... a message is printed in the job log indicating that these members have not been converted. However, no information regarding these members is placed in the report' (lines 33480-33484) - i.e. a stale V0601A from a previous run of this same manifest would be SILENTLY skipped (conversion-wise) with only a job-log message, while CRTBNDRPG would then happily recompile the STALE member and look like a success. To avoid this trap, the conversion step removes any existing V0601A member first (RMVM ... MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000), tolerating 'member does not exist') before calling CVTRPGSRC, the same DLTF-before-CRTPF idempotency pattern verify/part05-legacy-probe/manifest.json's CPFLDRF step already uses.
  - 'The name of the spooled file corresponds to the file name specified in the TOFILE parameter' (lines 33479-33480) - so the conversion report's spooled file is named QRPGLE112, not V0601A and not CVTRPGSRC.

Spooled-file retrieval mechanism and why it is NOT the harness's own default: verify/lib/batch.mjs's 'collect' step runs its SQL through a SEPARATE `db2 -s` shell invocation, outside the CL wrapper program that actually ran CVTRPGSRC/CRTBNDRPG/CALL (confirmed by reading batch.mjs directly - the collect loop is a distinct code path from the cl-steps' single CALL PGM(wrapper) invocation). verify/README.md's own 'known unverified' list already flags that qsh's separate system() calls are not confirmed to share a job, and SYSTOOLS.SPOOLED_FILE_DATA's default query in batch.mjs uses JOB_NAME => '*' (documented elsewhere as typically meaning 'the current job', not 'any job') plus JOB_USER => CURRENT_USER - if the collect step's own db2 invocation is a different job than the CL wrapper's, that default query would search the WRONG job's spooled files and most likely find nothing useful, exactly the kind of silent-failure this task was told to watch for. To sidestep that risk entirely rather than gamble on it, this manifest adds its own 'cl' steps (guaranteed to run inside the SAME single wrapper job that produced the QRPGLE112 spooled file, since verify/lib/clgen.mjs concatenates every 'cl' step into ONE CL program invoked by ONE 'system "CALL PGM(...)"'): CRTPF FILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) RCDLEN(133) to hold the text, then CPYSPLF FILE(QRPGLE112) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) SPLNBR(*LAST) JOB(*) CTLCHAR(*NONE) MBROPT(*REPLACE) to materialize the spooled file's text into that permanent physical file - this mirrors the exact same 'materialize inside the wrapper's own job, read back afterward with an ordinary SELECT' strategy verify/lib/clgen.mjs already uses for its own VFYLOG job-log dump, for the same underlying same-job-guarantee reason. The 'collect' step then just does a plain 'SELECT * FROM &LIB/VFYSPL', with no job-scoping question left at all. NOTE: CPYSPLF/CRTPF/RCDLEN(133) are ordinary CL command syntax, which neither ilerpgref75.txt nor ilerpgprogguide75.txt document in detail (both are RPG language references, not the CL command reference) - this is standard, extremely well-known IBM i usage, flagged here as unverified against this task's own two required primary sources rather than presented as reference-confirmed. 133 bytes (132-byte print line + 1 byte control character) is this task's own reasonable-but-unverified guess for CPYSPLF's default output record length; if it is wrong, CPYSPLF itself will fail with its own MONMSG-caught escape and the run simply proceeds without spooled-file text, rather than corrupting anything.

A second, independent 'collect' step is ALSO included, using the harness's own DEFAULT SYSTOOLS.SPOOLED_FILE_DATA query (verify/lib/batch.mjs, no custom sql given) as a first-attempt / comparison data point, per the task's own instruction to note when a retrieval mechanism has no verified prior art in this repo - verify/README.md itself already lists 'SYSTOOLS.SPOOLED_FILE_DATA の実際の呼び出し方(引数の形)' as one of the harness's own known-unverified points, and this is still true; this manifest does not resolve that, it just also tries it at no extra cost.

Safety of the CALL V0601A step: per docs/part04/04-08-jucinq3-report.md's own '実機メモ', R0408A was already hardware-verified on 2026-09-25 to compile with Highest Severity 00 and run non-interactively (CHAIN/READ against TOKUIM/JUCHUM, output via QSYSPRT+EXCPT, no interactive I/O, no divide) producing 'ACME TRADING CO' with J00001/J00003. Since CVTRPGSRC is documented as a mechanical column-position-to-column-position translation (also work/design/part06-design-v1.md's own note: 'CVTRPGSRCは機械的な桁位置→桁位置の変換であり...%BIFを使った現代的な書き方にはしない'), the converted V0601A is expected to preserve this exact non-interactive behavior, so CALLing it carries the same low risk R0408A itself already cleared.

steps.label: VSRCPF
steps.cmd: CRTSRCPF FILE(&LIB/QRPGLE112) RCDLEN(112) TEXT('P21/06-01 CVTRPGSRC target')

steps.label: VSPLPF
steps.cmd: CRTPF FILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) RCDLEN(133) TEXT('P21/06-01 spooled-file text capture')

steps.label: CVTSRC
steps.cmd:
RMVM FILE(&LIB/QRPGLE112) MBR(V0601A)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CVTRPGSRC FROMFILE(&LIB/QRPGSRC) FROMMBR(R0408A) TOFILE(&LIB/QRPGLE112) TOMBR(V0601A) CVTRPT(*YES) LOGFILE(*NONE)

steps.label: CPSPL
steps.cmd: CPYSPLF FILE(QRPGLE112) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) SPLNBR(*LAST) JOB(*) CTLCHAR(*NONE) MBROPT(*REPLACE)

steps.sql: SELECT SPOOLED_DATA FROM TABLE(SYSTOOLS.SPOOLED_FILE_DATA(JOB_NAME => '*', JOB_USER => CURRENT_USER, JOB_NUMBER => '*', SPOOLED_FILE_NAME => 'QRPGLE112', SPOOLED_FILE_NUMBER => -1)) X ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION
